purpose: Identity-safe oral anatomy and facial-expression bridge for MARS_CANONICAL
source_of_truth: MARS_CANONICAL remains the exterior identity mesh. Open anatomy is an inserted/retargeted subsystem, never a replacement head.
bridge: build an oral-only GNM donor from the official NPZ
measure MARS mouth landmarks and local face normal
fit the donor to the measured Mars mouth coordinate frame
use GNM-Studio constrained fitting for a Mars-specific lip deformation donor
retarget GNM lower-face expression to the Mars lip region
drive teeth/tongue/jaw from the same viseme signal
use Rhubarb only for audio phoneme timing
validate mouth gap, lip separation, tongue travel and blink closure

controls.viseme_EE: lip spread with bounded jaw contribution

hard_gates: jaw_open creates nonzero visible oral gap
lower teeth move while upper teeth remain anchored
no telemetry/placeholder can satisfy animation gates
